title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (doctrine) — review required
description: In doctrine, createQuerys*([^)]*(?:"[^"n]*$|.s*$) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via setParameter bindings.
applicability: doctrine data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
